stem: A fast-finishing cultivar would likely avoid autumn rain but place peak flowering into the region's hottest part of summer. What is the strongest planning approach?
choices: Compare the full likely development window against local heat, rain, frost and other risk periods rather than choosing only by advertised finish time
Choose the fastest cultivar because shorter always means lower risk
Ignore local climate if the cultivar is autoflowering
Use one advertised days-to-finish value as an exact outdoor schedule
rationale: Cultivar strategy is risk-timing design; shifting one vulnerable period can increase exposure to another seasonal hazard.
